Yesterday evening, a 22-year-old man surnamed Mu first called the police to commit suicide, and then drove a black sedan to the door of Nanzi Branch. Opening the back carriage, I was surprised to see that the man surnamed Zhang was clearly dead and busy, and was bent and placed in it. The police arrested him on the spot. The details of the case remain to be clarified. The Nanzi Branch of the Kaohsiung Municipal Police Bureau pointed out that the Mu man reported to the police yesterday that "I killed someone", and then drove to the police station. The police did not dare to gather a large number of police vigilance. They first controlled and inspected the vehicle, and found that a man in the rear carriage was lying on his back, and there was no sign of life. After the ambulance arrived, it was confirmed that there was an obvious death. A preliminary investigation by the police revealed that the deceased was a 22-year-old man surnamed Zhang, who was a colleague of the car wash. Zhang Male's body was bent and placed in the trunk. It is suspected that he was struck with a blunt object on the head. The two men were suspected of negotiating a debt agreement.

a8a338baaaf095e43110.en: Newtalk News The 9-in-1 election battle intensified at the end of the year. Shen Boyang, the Democratic Progressive Party's candidate for Taipei mayor, recently set off an "ocean current". Legislative President Han Yu will also launch a Taiwan-wide auxiliary election over the weekend. The outside world is concerned about whether the "Korean Stream" will return to the campaign and drive the blue camp election. In this regard, Chen Peiyu, deputy director of the Democratic Progressive Party Group, said today (1) that the media should not only focus on Han Yu, otherwise the Kuomintang, including Taichung Mayor Lu Xiuyan, Taipei Mayor Jiang Wan 'an and party chairman Zheng Liwen, "will be very unhappy", and pointed out that all four are potential candidates for the Kuomintang presidency in 2028. "In addition to the Korean Wave", you can also see whether "the power of Mother Lu" or "the power of Gongzi" of Jiang Wan 'an will be powerful. In response to Han Yu's upcoming auxiliary election, and is expected to stand for Jiang Qichen, Fan Yun, secretary of the Democratic Progressive Party Group, said that Han Yu and Jiang Qichen are the same political party after all, and the auxiliary election for the candidate of the same party is "people".
